title: 第一卷 第19章 各方观望第一卷 第20章 三大王级武技
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
现在，城主府与李、赵两大家族，皆选择了隔岸观火，静静观望事态的发展。
城主府。
城主杨海涛端坐于主位之上，一身玄色锦袍，眉宇间带着几分深沉。
他修为已至凝气境九层，在顾青山失踪后，他就是青云城明面上的第一强者。
现在只是一直隐而不发，维持着四大家族相互制衡的微妙局面。
下方，坐着一位身着青色官服的中年谋士。
他是杨海涛的心腹，负责为城主分析青云城的复杂局面。
杨海涛手指轻轻敲击着身前的桌子。
“据传，顾天阳已突破到凝气境了！”
谋士眼中闪过一丝讶异。
“凝气境？”
“那顾天阳年仅十八岁，便能突破至此，天赋确实不凡。”
“只是，即便他突破到凝气境，面对身后有青木宗撑腰的王嫣然，恐怕也难有胜算。”
杨海涛嘴角勾起一抹淡淡的冷笑。
“在绝对的实力面前，天赋一文不值。”
“青木宗是什么地方？”
“那是拥有灵海境大能坐镇的宗门，随手便可覆灭我青云城任何一个家族。”
“顾天阳就算突破凝气境，又能如何？”
“不过是螳臂当车罢了。”
他顿了顿，眼中闪过一丝算计。

“王嫣然此次带着青木宗的大长老前去退婚，目的绝不仅仅是退婚那么简单。”
“城主的意思是？”
“王家想要趁机灭了顾家？”
谋士试探着问道。
“大概率是这样。”
杨海涛点点头。
“如今顾家势弱，王家手握青木宗这张王牌，怎么可能放过这千载难逢的机会？”
“一旦顾家覆灭，王家独大，青云城的格局便会彻底改变。”
杨海涛摇了摇头，语气带着一丝玩味。
“让他们斗去吧！”
“无论是顾家覆灭，还是王家受挫，对我们城主府而言，都是好事。”
“我们要做的，就是静观其变！”
他说完，目光扫过下方坐着的谋士。
“传令下去，严密监视顾家与王家的动向，一有任何变故，立刻汇报。”
“另外，让城防军做好准备，若是事态失控，波及到城中百姓，再出手收场也不迟。”
“是！
属下这就去安排！”
谋士躬身领命，转身快步离去。
大殿内，杨海涛缓缓起身，走到窗边。
望着顾家所在的方向，眼中闪烁着复杂的光芒。
content_en:
Now, the City Lord's Mansion and the two major families, Li and Zhao, have chosen to watch the fire from the other side and quietly watch the development of the situation.
City Lord's Mansion.
City Lord Yang Haitao is sitting on the main throne, wearing a black brocade robe, with a somewhat deep look on his eyebrows.
His cultivation has reached the ninth level of Qi Condensation Realm. After Gu Qingshan disappeared, he was the most powerful person in Qingyun City.
Now it just remains hidden, maintaining the delicate situation of checks and balances between the four major families.
Below, sat a middle-aged counselor wearing a blue official uniform.
He is Yang Haitao's confidant and is responsible for analyzing the complex situation of Qingyun City for the city lord.
Yang Haitao tapped his fingers lightly on the table in front of him.
"It is rumored that Gu Tianyang has broken through to the Qi Condensation Realm!"
A trace of surprise flashed in the counselor's eyes.
"Qi Condensation Realm?"
"Then Gu Tianyang is only eighteen years old and can break through to this level. His talent is indeed extraordinary."
"However, even if he breaks through to the Qi Condensation Realm, he may not have a chance of winning against Wang Yanran with the support of the Qingmu Sect behind him."
A faint sneer appeared at the corner of Yang Haitao's mouth.
"Talent is worthless in the face of absolute strength."
"Where is the Qingmu Sect?"
"That is a sect with powerful people in the Spiritual Sea Realm. They can easily destroy any family in Qingyun City."
"Even if Gu Tianyang breaks through the Qi Condensation Realm, what will happen?"
"It's just a mantis using its arms as a cart."
He paused, a hint of calculation flashing in his eyes.
"Wang Yanran brought the great elder of the Qingmu Sect to break off the engagement this time. The purpose is not just as simple as breaking off the engagement."
"What does the city lord mean?"
"The Wang family wants to take the opportunity to destroy the Gu family?"
The counselor asked tentatively.
"That's most likely the case."
Yang Haitao nodded.
"Now that the Gu family is weak and the Wang family holds the trump card of the Qingmu Sect, how could they let go of this golden opportunity?"
"Once the Gu family is destroyed and the Wang family becomes dominant, the structure of Qingyun City will completely change."
Yang Haitao shook his head, with a hint of amusement in his tone.
"Let them fight!"
"Whether it is the destruction of the Gu family or the setback of the Wang family, it is a good thing for our City Lord's Mansion."
"What we have to do is wait and see what happens!"
After he finished speaking, his eyes glanced at the counselor sitting below.
"Send the order, closely monitor the movements of the Gu family and the Wang family, and report immediately if there are any changes."
"In addition, let the city defense army be prepared. If the situation gets out of control and affects the people in the city, it will not be too late to take action to end it."
"Yes!
My subordinates will make arrangements now! "
The counselor bowed to accept the order, turned around and left quickly.
In the main hall, Yang Haitao slowly stood up and walked to the window.
Looking in the direction of the Gu family, a complicated light flashed in his eyes.
